summary: The registrant, Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust, filed an 8-K reporting the unregistered sale of 3,452,243 Class I common shares at NAV for gross proceeds of ~$36.8M. It also disclosed monthly NAV per share by class as of April 30, 2026. This is a routine capital raise under exemption and a periodic NAV disclosure. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation elements. The filing is an ordinary current report for a non-listed REIT, not a special situation.
